nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

nexscope/inputExamples.prompt: Introduce this shockproof phone case in an upbeat tone.

description: Create a product-selling video from prompt and product image references.

imageList.description: Public product image URLs. Provide up to 30 images for Seedance 2.5 or up to 9 images for the other supported models.

isPro.description: Enable Pro mode for any Seedance model. HappyHorse V2 does not support Pro mode. When enabled without resolution, the default is 720p.

prompt.example: Introduce this shockproof phone case in an upbeat tone.

resolution.description: Target resolution. Seedance 2.0 and 2.5 support 480p, 720p, or 1080p; Seedance Fast and Mini support 480p or 720p; HappyHorse V2 supports 720p or 1080p.

videoTime.description: Target duration in seconds. Seedance 2.0, Fast, Mini, and HappyHorse V2 support 5, 10, or 15; Seedance 2.5 also supports 30.

videoType.description: Video model. Supported values: seedance-2-0, seedance-2-0-fast, seedance-2-0-mini, seedance-2-5, or happyhorse-v2.

name: nexscope_sales_talking_video
title: Sales Talking Video API
